verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Subhaanal-ladhee asraa bi-abdihi laylan minal-masjidil-haraami ilal-masjidil-aqsal-ladhee baaraknaa hawlahu linuriyahu min aayaatinaa innahu huwas-samee'ul-baseer
Wa aataynaa moosal-kitaaba wa ja'alnaahu hudan libanee israa'eela allaa tattakhidhoo min doonee wakeelaa
Dhurriyyata man hamalnaa ma'a noohin innahu kaana abdan shakooraa
Wa qadaynaa ilaa banee israa'eela fil-kitaabi latufsidunna fil-ardi marratayni wa lata'lunna uluwwan kabeeraa
Fa-idhaa jaa'a wa'du oolaahumaa ba'athnaa alaykum ibaadan lanaa ulee ba'sin shadeedin fajaasoo khilaalad-diyaari wa kaana wa'dan maf'oolaa
Thumma radadnaa lakumul-karrata alayhim wa amdadnaakum bi-amwaalin wa baneena wa ja'alnaakum akthara nafeeraa
In ahsantum ahsantum li'nfusikum wa in asa'tum falahaa fa-idhaa jaa'a wa'dul-aakhirati liyasoo'oo wujoohakum wa liyadkhulul-masjida kamaa dakhaloohu awwala marratin wa liyutabbiroo maa alaw tatbeeraa
Asaa rabbukum an yarhamakum wa in udtum udnaa wa ja'alnaa jahannama lilkaafireena haseeraa
Inna haadhal-qur'aana yahdee lillatee hiya aqwamu wa yubashshirul-mu'mineenal-ladheena ya'maloonas-saalihaati anna lahum ajran kabeeraa
Wa annal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati a'tadnaa lahum adhaaban aleemaa
Wa yad'ul-insaanu bish-sharri du'aa'ahu bil-khayri wa kaanal-insaanu ajoolaa

Wa ja'alnal-layla wan-nahaara aayatayni famahawnaa aayatal-layli wa ja'alnaa aayatan-nahaari mubsiratan litabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum wa lita'lamoo adadas-sineena wal-hisaaba wa kulla shay'in fassalnaahu tafseelaa
Wa kulla insaanin alzamnaahu taa'irahu fee unuqihi wa nukhriju lahu yawmal-qiyaamati kitaaban yalqaahu manshooraa
Iqra kitaabaka kafaa binafsikal-yawma alayka haseebaa
Manih-tadaa fa-innamaa yahtadee linafsihi wa man dalla fa-innamaa yadillu alayhaa wa laa taziru waaziratun wizra ukhraa wa maa kunnaa mu'adhdhibeena hattaa nab'atha rasoolaa
Wa idhaa aradnaa an nuhlika qaryatan amarnaa mutrafeehaa fafasaqoo feehaa fahaqqa alayhal-qawlu fadammarnaahaa tadmeeraa
Wa kam ahlaknaa minal-qurooni min ba'di noohin wa kafaa birabbika bidhunoobi ibaadihi khabeeran baseeraa
Man kaana yureedul-aajilata ajjalnaa lahu feehaa maa nashaa'u liman nureedu thumma ja'alnaa lahu jahannama yaslaahaa madhmooman madhooraa
Wa man araadal-aakhirata wa sa'aa lahaa sa'yahaa wa huwa mu'minun fa-ulaa'ika kaana sa'yuhum mashkooraa
Kullan numiddu haa'ulaa'i wa haa'ulaa'i min ataa'i rabbika wa maa kaana ataa'u rabbika mahzooraa
Unzur kayfa faddalnaa ba'dahum alaa ba'din wa lal-aakhiratu akbaru darajaatin wa akbaru tafdeelaa
Laa taj'al ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara fataq'uda madhmooman makhdhoolaa

Wa qadaa rabbuka allaa ta'budoo illaa iyyaahu wa bil-waalidayni ihsaanan immaa yablughanna indakal-kibara ahaduhumaa aw kilaahumaa falaa taqul lahumaa uffin wa laa tanharhumaa wa qul lahumaa qawlan kareemaa
Wakhfid lahumaa janaahadh-dhulli minar-rahmati wa qul rabbi irhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa
Rabbukum a'lamu bimaa fee nufoosikum in takoonoo saaliheena fa-innahu kaana lil-awwaabeena ghafooraa
Wa aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahu wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeeli wa laa tubadhdhir tabdheeraa
Innal-mubadhdhireena kaanoo ikhwaanash-shayaateeni wa kaanash-shaytaanu lirabbihi kafooraa
Wa immaa tu'ridanna anhumu ibtighaa'a rahmatin min rabbika tarjoohaa faqul lahum qawlan maysooraa
Wa laa taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ilaa unuqika wa laa tabsuthaa kullal-basti fataq'uda malooman mahsooraa
Inna rabbaka yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru innahu kaana bi-ibaadihi khabeeran baseeraa
Wa laa taqtuloo awlaadakum khashyata imlaaqin nahnu narzuquhum wa iyyaakum inna qatlahum kaana khit'an kabeeraa
Wa laa taqrabuz-zinaa innahu kaana faahishatan wa saa'a sabeelaa
Wa laa taqtulun-nafsal-latee harrama Allaahu illaa bil-haqqi wa man qutila mazlooman faqad ja'alnaa liwaliyyihi sultaanan falaa yusrif fil-qatli innahu kaana mansooraa
Wa laa taqraboo maalal-yateemi illaa billatee hiya ahsanu hattaa yablugha ashuddahu wa awfoo bil-ahdi innal-ahda kaana mas'oolaa
Wa awful-kayla idhaa kiltum wa zinoo bil-qistaasil-mustaqeemi dhaalika khayrun wa ahsanu ta'weelaa
Wa laa taqfu maa laysa laka bihi ilmun innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'uaada kullu ulaa'ika kaana anhu mas'oolaa
Wa laa tamshi fil-ardi marahan innaka lan takhriqal-arda wa lan tablughal-jibaala toolaa
Kullu dhaalika kaana sayyi'uhu inda rabbika makroohaa
Dhaalika mimmaa awhaa ilayka rabbuka minal-hikmati wa laa taj'al ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara fatulqaa fee jahannama malooman madhooraa
Afa'asfaakum rabbukum bil-baneena wattakhadha minal-malaa'ikati inaathan innakum lataqooloona qawlan azeemaa
Wa laqad sarrafnaa fee haadhal-qur'aani liyadhdhakkaroo wa maa yazeeduhum illaa nufooraa
Qul law kaana ma'ahu aalihatun kamaa yaqooloona idhan labtaghaw ilaa dhil-arshi sabeelaa
Subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yaqooloona uluwwan kabeeraa
Tusabbihu lahus-samaawaatus-sab'u wal-ardu wa man feehinna wa in min shay'in illaa yusabbihu bihamdihi wa laakin laa tafqahoona tasbeehahum innahu kaana haleeman ghafooraa
Wa idhaa qara'tal-qur'aana ja'alnaa baynaka wa baynal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati hijaaban mastooraa
Wa ja'alnaa alaa quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wa fee aadhaanihim waqran wa idhaa dhakarta rabbaka fil-qur'aani wahdahu wallaw alaa adbaarihim nufooraa
Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yastami'oona bihi idh yastami'oona ilayka wa idh hum najwaa idh yaqooluz-zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulan mashooraa
Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa
Wa qaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa izaaman wa rufaatan a'innaa lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
Qul koonoo hijaaratan aw hadeedaa
Aw khalqan mimmaa yakburu fee sudoorikum fasayaqooloona man yu'eedunaa qulil-ladhee fatarakum awwala marratin fasayunghidoona ilayka ru'oosahum wa yaqooloona mataa huwa qul asaa an yakoona qareebaa
Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi wa tazunnoona in labithtum illaa qaleelaa
Wa qul li-ibaadee yaqoolul-latee hiya ahsanu innash-shaytaana yanzaghu baynahum innash-shaytaana kaana lil-insaani aduwwan mubeenaa
Rabbukum a'lamu bikum in yasha yarhamkum aw in yasha yu'adhdhibkum wa maa arsalnaaka alayhim wakeelaa
Wa rabbuka a'lamu biman fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa laqad faddalnaa ba'dan-nabiyyeena alaa ba'din wa aataynaa daawooda zabooraa
Qulid-ul-ladheena za'amtum min doonihi falaa yamlikoona kashfad-durri ankum wa laa tahweelaa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena yad'oona yabtaghoona ilaa rabbihimul-waseelata ayyuhum aqrabu wa yarjoona rahmatahu wa yakhaafoona adhaabahu inna adhaaba rabbika kaana mahdhooraa
Wa in min qaryatin illaa nahnu muhlikoohaa qabla yawmil-qiyaamati aw mu'adhdhiboohaa adhaaban shadeedan kaana dhaalika fil-kitaabi mastooraa
Wa maa mana'anaa an nursila bil-aayaati illaa an kadhdhaba bihal-awwaloona wa aataynaa thamoodan-naaqata mubsiratan fazalamoo bihaa wa maa nursilu bil-aayaati illaa takhweefaa

Wa idh qulnaa laka inna rabbaka ahaata bin-naasi wa maa ja'alnar-ru'yal-latee araynaaka illaa fitnatan lin-naasi wash-shajaratal-mal-oonata fil-qur'aani wa nukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhum illaa tughyaanan kabeeraa
Wa idh qulnaa lilmalaa'ikati usjudoo li'dama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa qaala a'asjudu liman khalaqta teenaa
Qaala ara'aytaka haadhal-ladhee karramta alayya la-in akhkhartanee ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati la-ahtanikanna dhurriyyatahu illaa qaleelaa
Qaaladh-hab faman tabi'aka minhum fa-inna jahannama jazaa'uukum jazaa'an mawfooraa
Wastafziz manis-tata'ta minhum bisawtika wa ajlib alayhim bikhaylika wa rajilika wa shaarikhum fil-amwli wal-awlaadi wa idhum wa maa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu illaa ghurooraa
Inna ibaadee laysa laka alayhim sultaanun wa kafaa birabbika wakeelaa
Rabbukumul-ladhee yuzjee lakumul-fulka fil-bahri litabtaghoo min fadlihi innahu kaana bikum Raheemaa
Wa idhaa massakumud-durru fil-bahri dalla man tad'oona illaa iyyaahu falammaa najjaakum ilal-barri a'radtum wa kaanal-insaanu kafooraa
Afa'amintum an yakhsifa bikum jaanibal-barri aw yursila alaykum haasiban thumma laa tajidoo lakum wakeelaa
Am amintum an yu'eedakum feehi taaratan ukhraa fayursila alaykum qaasifan minar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidoo lakum alaynaa bihi tabee'aa
Wa laqad karramnaa banee aadama wa hamalnaahum fil-barri wal-bahri wa razaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wa faddalnaahum alaa katheerin mimman khalaqnaa tafdeelaa
Yawma nad'oo kulla unaasin bi-imaamihim faman ootiya kitaabahu biyameenihi fa-ulaa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum wa laa yuzlamoona fateelaa
Wa man kaana fee haadhihi a'maa fahuwa fil-aakhirati a'maa wa adallu sabeelaa
Wa in kaadoo layaftinoonaka anil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka litaftariya alaynaa ghayrahu wa idhan laattakhadhooka khaleelaa
Wa lawlaa an thabbatnaaka laqad kidtta tarkanu ilayhim shay'an qaleelaa
Idhan la-adhaqnaaka di'fal-hayaati wa di'fal-mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka alaynaa naseeraa
Wa in kaadoo layastafizzoonaka minal-ardi liyukhrijooka minhaa wa idhan laa yalbathoona khilaafaka illaa qaleelaa
Sunnata man qad arsalnaa qablaka min rusulinaa wa laa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweelaa
Aqimis-salaata lidulookish-shamsi ilaa ghasaqil-layli wa qur'aanal-fajri inna qur'aanal-fajri kaana mashhoodaa
Wa minal-layli fatahajjad bihi naafilatan laka asaa an yab'athaka rabbuka maqaaman mahmoodaa
Wa qul rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waj'al lee min ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
Wa qul jaa'al-haqqu wa zahaqal-baatilu innal-baatila kaana zahooqaa
Wa nunazzilu minal-qur'aani maa huwa shifaa'un wa rahmatun lilmu'mineena wa laa yazeeduz-zaalimeena illaa khasaaraa
Wa idhaa an'amnaa alal-insaani a'rada wa na'aa bijaanibihi wa idhaa massahush-sharru kaana ya'oosaa
Qul kullun ya'malu alaa shaakilatihi farabbukum a'lamu biman huwa ahdaa sabeelaa
Wa yas'aloonaka anir-roohi qulir-roohu min amri rabbee wa maa ooteetum minal-ilmi illaa qaleelaa
Wa la-in shi'naa lanadhhabanna billadhee awhaynaa ilayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihi alaynaa wakeelaa
Illaa rahmatan min rabbika inna fadlahu kaana alayka kabeeraa
Qul la-ini ijtama'atil-insu wal-jinnu alaa an ya'too bimithli haadhal-qur'aani laa ya'toona bimithlihi wa law kaana ba'duhum liba'din zaheeraa
Wa laqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalin fa-abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
Wa qaaloo lan nu'mina laka hattaa tafjura lanaa minal-ardi yanboo'aa
Aw takoona laka jannatun min nakheelin wa inabin fatufajjiral-anhaara khilaalahaa tafjeeraa
Aw tusqitas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta alaynaa kisafan aw ta'tiya Billaahi wal-malaa'ikati qabeelaa
Aw yakoona laka baytun min zukhrufin aw tarqaa fis-samaa'i wa lan nu'mina liruqiyyika hattaa tunazzila alaynaa kitaaban naqra'uuhu qul subhaana rabbee hal kuntu illaa basharan rasoolaa
Wa maa mana'an-naasa an yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa illaa an qaaloo aba'atha Allaahu basharan rasoolaa
Qul law kaana fil-ardi malaa'ikatun yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzalnaa alayhim minas-samaa'i malakan rasoolaa
Qul kafaa Billaahi shaheedan baynee wa baynakum innahu kaana bi-ibaadihi khabeeran baseeraa

Wa man yahdi Allaahu fahuwal-muhtadi wa man yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa'a min doonihi wa nahshuruhum yawmal-qiyaamati alaa wajoohihim umyan wa bukman wa summan ma'waahum jahannamu kullamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eeraa
Dhaalika jazaa'uuhum bi-annahum kafaroo bi-aayaatinaa wa qaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa izaaman wa rufaatan a'innaa lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda qaadirun alaa an yakhluqa mithlahum wa ja'ala lahum ajalan laa rayba feehi fa-abaz-zaalimoona illaa kufooraa
Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbee idhan la-amsaktum khashyatal-infaaqi wa kaanal-insaanu qatooraa
Wa laqad aataynaa moosaa tis'a aayaatin bayyinaatin faas'l banee israa'eela idh jaa'ahum faqaala lahu fir'awnu innee la-azunnuka yaamoosaa mashooraa
Qaala laqad alimta maa anzala haa'ulaa'i illaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi basaa'ira wa innee la-azunnuka yaa fir'awnu mathbooraa
Fa-araada an yastafizzahum minal-ardi fa-aghraqnaahu wa man ma'ahu jamee'aa
Wa qulnaa min ba'dihi libanee israa'eela uskunul-arda fa-idhaa jaa'a wa'dul-aakhirati ji'naa bikum lafeefaa
Wa bil-haqqi anzalnaahu wa bil-haqqi nazala wa maa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiran wa nadheeraa
Wa qur'aanan faraqnaahu litaqra'ahu alan-naasi alaa mukthin wa nazzalnaahu tanzeelaa
Qul aaminoo bihi aw laa tu'minoo innal-ladheena ootul-ilma min qablihi idhaa yutlaa alayhim yakhirroona lil-adhqaani sujjadaa
Wa yaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'oolaa
Wa yakhirroona lil-adhqaani yabkoona wa yazeeduhum khushoo'aa
Qul ud'oo Allaaha aw ud'ur-Rahmaana ayyanan maa tad'oo falahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa wa laa tajhar bisalaatika wa laa tukhaafit bihaa wabtaghi bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
Wa qulil-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu shareekun fil-mulki wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun minadh-dhulli wa kabbirhu takbeeraa
